description:
3W Clinic Charcoal Cleansing Foam 100 ml is a Korean foaming facial cleanser formulated to remove daily dirt, excess sebum and surface impurities while leaving the skin feeling clean and refreshed. Its rich, creamy foam makes it particularly suitable for people who prefer a thorough cleansing feel.

The formula contains Charcoal Powder (0.1%), an adsorbent cosmetic ingredient commonly used in cleansing products to help pick up excess oil and impurities from the skin surface. The cleanser also contains Witch Hazel Extract, Bamboo Extract and Portulaca Oleracea Extract as supporting botanical ingredients.

This is primarily a soap-based, high-foaming cleanser. Stearic Acid, Myristic Acid and Lauric Acid are combined with Potassium Hydroxide to create its cleansing and foaming system, while Cocamidopropyl Betaine provides additional surfactant support. Glycerin and Sorbitan Olivate help balance the cleansing formula with moisturizing and conditioning properties.

Because it provides a relatively thorough cleansing experience, 3W Clinic Charcoal Cleansing Foam may be especially appealing to oily and combination skin or skin that frequently feels greasy. Dry or easily sensitized skin should begin with once-daily use and adjust according to comfort. The product contains added fragrance as well as Methylparaben and Propylparaben, so it should not be described as fragrance-free or paraben-free.
